displayDescription: Cream monoline bulb draws, an arrow hands off, nodes then connectors draw, and a copper route traces the path on a deep teal field.
motionEngine: GSAP core timeline (stroke-dashoffset path reveals, clip wipe, opacity/scale)
audioDescription: Silent. No music, voice or sound effects.
limitations: Line reveals use stroke-dasharray/dashoffset under GSAP core rather than DrawSVGPlugin. The visual result is equivalent.
The lamp glow is a flat copper disc at 20% opacity, an approximation of emitted light. It is not a lighting simulation.
The dark field reuses the palette foreground token #27434A, with cream #F9F4E7 for lines and type. This inverts the authored scheme and adds no new hue.
Copper #AA6945 on the dark field measures about 2.3:1, so copper is used only on strokes, never on text.
Footer step positions are measured from the system monospace font at load time, so spacing can vary slightly with font fallback.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA is pending.
